v0 run. Black-headed tricolor renders the same as tricolor (mask multiplied by 0, line 275).

First v1 run. Rule 1 deviation: the harness was started in the repo root instead of an empty folder, so directory listings showed runs/ and the two v0 entries' filenames; their contents were never opened. The run was interrupted by a power outage and resumed in a fresh folder from the session transcript; wall_min is model working time and excludes the 18-minute gap. Has an adaptive quality fallback (pixel ratio, then shell count) but it only engages above 29 ms/frame, so it does not trigger at 400x400 DPR 2.

v1 run. Effort label taken from the run folder name (haiku-5.5-high). Harness started in its own working folder; no other files were read. Checked in headless Chrome at 400x400 DPR 2 from file://: loads with no console errors; back, side, low and high views and click wiggles were viewed. Wall time, tokens and cost were not recorded.

v1 run. Raw WebGL2, no Three.js or other external resource: SDF-meshed body with 34-shell fur, seeded sfc32 streams, 7 wiggle types, damped-spring fur lag. Self-checked in headless Chrome at 400x400 DPR 2 from file://: no console errors, seed/coat hash handling, click at canvas centre, orbit limits and wiggle bounds verified. About 4.8 ms GPU time/frame on an M4 (not measured on an M1); adaptive quality exists but did not trigger on the M4. The trunk fades into the ground colour, so straight-on front views show a soft fog window. The file keeps a few harmless window.__corgi debug hooks. The harness ran in a folder alongside other runs' folders; none were read. Wall time, tokens and cost were not recorded.
